subject: general
question: The difference between the interior and exterior angles at a vertex of a regular polygon is 140°. The number is sides of the polygon is:
solution:
Given:

The difference between the exterior and interior angles at a vertex of a regular polygon is 140°

Formula Used:

Interior angle of a polygon having side n = (n – 2)180°/n

Calculations:

Let Ai and Ae be interior and exterior angles

Sum of Ai and Ae = 180°,

So, Ai + Ae = 180

∴ Ai - Ae = 140

So, solving for Ae & Ai

Ae = 20°

Ai = 160°

Interior angle of a polygon having side n = (n – 2)180°/n

∴ 160° = (n – 2)180°/n

⇒ 160n = 180n – 360

⇒ 360 = 20n

⇒ n = 18

Thus the number of sides are 18.
